card.name: Emphatic "that's X!" exclamations
card.fires_on: The word right after a demonstrative opener like "that's", "that is", "this is" or "what I call", where the writer labels something with an emphatic phrase. It fires on the contraction 's or the first word of the label.

modes.label: After "now that"
modes.description: The 's contraction in an informal exclamation such as "now that's hot!" or "now that's my kind of stick!".
modes.example: Now that<<’s>> hot! Apples? We ain’t

modes.label: Labelling phrase
modes.description: The first word or piece of the label after "that is", "this is" or "what I call", naming something emphatically.
modes.example: “Well, this is what I call<< luck>>!" exclaimed Ferd Stowing.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words that name or label a thing, such as "叫做" (called), "excellence" and superlatives.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where the writer says "that's what you call..." and sums something up with a punchy label.
